written.headline: Google expands TPU family with TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max systems
written.summary: Google announced two eighth-generation Tensor Processing Unit systems: the TPU 8tx for secure confidential inference paired with AMD CPUs, and the TPU 8i Max dual-chip package for long-context window tasks, scheduled to launch in 2027. The hardware additions are paired with new developer software including native PyTorch support and an open-source XLA Serving Engine.

written.headline: Apple Intelligence registers with Chinese regulator for tablets and laptops
written.summary: Apple's generative AI service, Apple Intelligence, has been registered for use on tablets and laptops with China's cyberspace regulator in Shanghai. China requires large language models and generative AI services to be registered with regulators before public release.

written.headline: Adobe integrates CX Enterprise Coworker into ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini
written.summary: Adobe embedded its CX Enterprise Coworker agent into platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, Databricks Genie, Gemini for business, and Microsoft Copilot. The AI agent helps marketing teams orchestrate customer experiences using open standards like MCP and A2A.

written.headline: Sarvam AI appoints ex-Google Cloud India MD Sashikumar Sreedharan as President and CBO
written.summary: Indian AI startup Sarvam AI appointed former Google Cloud India Managing Director Sashikumar Sreedharan as President and Chief Business Officer. Sreedharan brings over three decades of technology industry experience to his new roles on the executive team and board of directors.
